exclusion: Severe head trauma in the past
History of ischemic stroke or hemorrhage
Metal implants in the head/neck region
inclusion: Patients with a cerebellar syndrome and quantifiable cerebellar atrophy

interventions.description: Single session of Transcranial stimulation over the cerebellar hemispheres
interventions.name: Transcranial stimulation over the cerebellar hemispheres

official_title: Interventional Cross-over Study to Evaluate the Efficacy on Motor and Cognitive Performance of Transcranial Alternating Current Stimulation (tACS) in Patients With Neurodegenerative Ataxia
sponsor: Azienda Socio Sanitaria Territoriale degli Spedali Civili di Brescia
summary: The aim of the study is to evaluate the effects on motor and cognitive performance of transcranial alternating current stimulation (tACS) compared to transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) and placebo stimulation (sham) in patients with neurodegenerative ataxia to identify a possible rehabilitation protocol.
title: Transcranial Alternating Current Stimulation (tACS) in Patients With Ataxia
